name: M2.5 heat-set insert (CNC Kitchen M2.5 x 4)
summary: Brass insert melted into a printed part. Needs a 4 mm hole at least 5 mm deep.
source: CNC Kitchen metric insert table: M2.5 x 4 is 4 mm long and 4.6 mm across the knurl, wants a 4 mm hole at least 5 mm deep and at least 1.6 mm of plastic around the hole. Other brands of the same nominal size differ by a few tenths, so test-fit one before printing a whole enclosure.
